title: Plant protein or animal protein? 🌱🍗
caption:
Animal protein has all the building blocks and more leucine; many plant proteins have less, but mixing sources fixes it. In a 12-week study, vegans and meat eaters eating the same protein built the same muscle. Total protein matters most. Team plant or team animal? 👇

General information, not medical advice.
